# ferentin_workload_oauth_client_test (Data Source)

Probes a `ferentin_workload_oauth_client` against its bound IdP and exposes the result. Each plan / apply triggers a fresh round-trip — gate downstream resources on `overall_pass` to fail fast when the IdP config is broken.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Probe an existing workload OAuth client against its bound IdP and surface
# the result. Each plan / apply re-runs the probe — useful for guardrailing
# config in CI.

data "ferentin_workload_oauth_client_test" "salesforce_check" {
  client_id = ferentin_workload_oauth_client.salesforce_cc.client_id_resource
}

# Use the result to gate downstream resources or surface in outputs.
output "salesforce_idp_reachable" {
  value = data.ferentin_workload_oauth_client_test.salesforce_check.overall_pass
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `client_id` (String) UUID of the workload OAuth client to probe.

### Optional

- `tenant_id` (String) Tenant UUID. Defaults to provider-level value.

### Read-Only

- `error` (String) Sanitized top-level error category when the mint failed (one of `config`, `connection_refused`, `timeout`, `unauthorized`, `forbidden`, `rate_limited`, `server_error`, `generic`). Null on success.
- `error_detail` (String) Operator-actionable hint for the `error` category.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `overall_pass` (Boolean) True iff every per-check assertion passed.
- `token_endpoint` (String) The token endpoint the probe hit, echoed back.
- `token_type` (String) `jwt` (3-segment JWT), `opaque`, or null on hard mint failure.
